chapter: New Orleans bands, players and halls
title: New Orleans drummers: Cantrell, Mac Murray and John Vigne
summary: Foster says few New Orleans drummers could fit any band and praises John Vigne's shuffle beat.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You know, we're going to get back to some... We had some very... We didn't have but one or two good drummers around, Ron Wallings. I mean, real drummers. The drummers that could fit with any kind of band. And they was from some of the French boys, like Cantrell.
You remember Mac Murray's real name?

Well, John Veeam. John Veeam was a jazz drummer all his life. The same stuff that the guys is doing right now, John Veeam was doing that years and years ago. That shuffle beat, see? But didn't know nothing about it.
